description: Log sets hands-free in the gym with 100% on-device Apple Speech or WhisperKit transcription and Qwen2.5-1.5B workout parsing & coaching. Includes Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen quick log, and Dynamic Island Live Activities.

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Offline voice-first gym log & AI coach
apps.localizedDescription:
Buddy is an iPhone-native, fully offline workout logger built for fast hands-free set tracking between sets.

• 1-tap voice logging from the app, Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Dynamic Island
• Built-in Apple On-Device Speech with live captions & accent picker, plus switchable WhisperKit CoreML (Large v3 Turbo / Small / Base)
• Local Qwen2.5-1.5B intent parser & instant zero-latency rule-based parsing
• Automatic multi-set expansion, undo, and quick inline editing
• Consistency streaks, 7-day volume charts, heatmaps, and per-exercise progression trends
• Local AI Gym Coach grounded in your workout history
• Dynamic SideStore App Group resolution so widgets stay synced after free Apple ID re-signing
